name: Chongqing hot pot base
where: Chongbai food hall or a local large supermarket
about: A spicy broth base used for Chongqing-style hot pot, the city's best-known food. It is sold as a packaged seasoning for home cooking.
tip: Check the ingredients: some bases contain beef tallow or meat, so look for a plant-based version if you need one.

name: Ronchang ramie fan
where: Chongqing Gifts shop that sells Rongchang xiabu (ramie cloth)
about: A hand fan woven from ramie cloth, a craft tied to Rongchang district near Chongqing. The fine fiber has been woven there for generations.
tip: Confirm the fabric is xiabu and check where the fan was made before you pay.
